steamOfflineGuide.bannerDesc: Learn how to install, turn off Steam Cloud, activate Denuvo, and switch to Offline Mode to play smoothly without losing access.
steamOfflineGuide.modalSubtitle: Step-by-step account configuration, Denuvo activation, and troubleshooting common issues
steamOfflineGuide.quickNotice1: ⚠️ Notice: After Signing In > "GAME FINISHED DOWNLOADING": (1) Turn off Steam Cloud > Enter game in (2) Online Mode once to activate DENUVO key > Exit and switch Steam to (2) OFFLINE MODE (disconnect network) before clicking Play. See Detailed Guide below 👇🏻
steamOfflineGuide.quickNotice2: ⚠️ Notice: DENUVO games limit activations per machine. To avoid errors, check "Remember Me" to retain your DENUVO key > If switching accounts, only click Change Account, NEVER click Sign out, as this loses the DENUVO key and requires waiting to reactivate.
steamOfflineGuide.step1Title: Step 1: Sign in to Steam and check "Remember me"
steamOfflineGuide.step1Bullet1: This ensures the device remembers your login and won't ask for credentials next time.
steamOfflineGuide.step1Bullet2: Must log in using the installed desktop Steam client (not browser or mobile app).
steamOfflineGuide.step2Title: Step 2: When switching accounts, click ''Change Account''
steamOfflineGuide.step2Bullet1: Clicking Change Account avoids needing the login code again next time.
steamOfflineGuide.step2Bullet2: Clicking Change Account also retains the Denuvo key (avoiding reactivation next time).
steamOfflineGuide.step2Bullet3: DO NOT click Sign out as this loses the Denuvo key and requires a new login code next time.
steamOfflineGuide.step3Title: Step 3: How to disable Steam Cloud
steamOfflineGuide.step3Desc: Open Steam > Click "Steam" (top left) > select "Settings" > "Cloud" (1) > Toggle "Enable Steam Cloud" to gray (off).
steamOfflineGuide.step4Title: Step 4: Download game and activate Denuvo
steamOfflineGuide.step4Desc: In Steam > Go to "LIBRARY" > "Click on the game" > Click INSTALL > Once installed, click PLAY in Online mode once (to activate DENUVO key).
steamOfflineGuide.step4Note: Note: If you do not see the "INSTALL" or "PLAY" button, click the dropdown triangle next to "STREAM" > Select "This Device".
steamOfflineGuide.step5Title: Step 5: Switch Steam to Offline Mode
steamOfflineGuide.step5Desc: After activating the DENUVO key, Exit the game > Switch Steam to Offline Mode then launch and play normally. To switch to Offline Mode: In Steam > Click "Steam" > "Go Offline...".
steamOfflineGuide.issue1Title: 1. Fix Unable to Log in to Account
steamOfflineGuide.issue1Desc: => Almost all login errors are caused by ISPs blocking Steam. To fix this, try turning VPN Warp 1.1.1.1 on or off and log in again. Toggle until resolved.
steamOfflineGuide.issue1LinkText: If you have not installed Warp 1.1.1.1 yet, visit
steamOfflineGuide.issue2Desc: Click "Steam" (top-left) > Settings > Remote Play > Toggle switch to gray to disable Remote Play (applies if not using gamepad streaming).
steamOfflineGuide.issue3Title: 3. Fix error "Steam is currently in Offline Mode, for the first launch go in Online Mode"
steamOfflineGuide.issue3Desc: => This error requires Online mode to activate Denuvo for a new device => Switch to Online Mode to activate and perform initial setup, then switch back to Offline Mode to play.
steamOfflineGuide.issue4Desc: => Occurs on DENUVO games when activations exceed 5 times/day on new devices. Wait and retry later (try every 3 hours), or contact support for an alternative account.
